title: Selected Work — projects
description: Projects shown in Section 04. Edit projects.json; VS Code shows these descriptions on hover and warns about missing fields. Order in the array = order on the page.

localizedText.description: Text per language. "en" is required; "pt-BR" and "es" fall back to English when missing.

localizedList.description: List of short items per language. "en" is required; other languages fall back to English when missing or empty.

slug.description: ✏️ EDIT — unique id in lowercase-with-dashes. Used in the case-study link (#work-<slug>).

sample.description: ✏️ EDIT — true = example data (shows a 'Sample project' badge on the site). Set to false for your real projects.

name.description: ✏️ EDIT — client name, or a neutral description if confidential.

confidential.description: ✏️ EDIT — true shows 'Confidential client' instead of a logo/link.

summary.description: ✏️ EDIT — one sentence shown under the name.

approach.description: ✏️ EDIT — 3–5 steps of how the project was run (full case study).

scope.description: ✏️ EDIT — what you were responsible for (full case study).

technologies.description: ✏️ EDIT — technology names, same in every language.

image.description: ✏️ EDIT — path inside /public, e.g. "/projects/my-project.webp". Recommended 1600×1000 (16:10), WebP or JPG.

alt.description: ✏️ EDIT — describe what the image shows (accessibility).

outcomes.description: ✏️ OPTIONAL — only real, client-approved results. Leave empty lists to hide the block. Never invent numbers.

live.description: ✏️ OPTIONAL — public URL of the product, or null.

caseStudy.description: ✏️ OPTIONAL — external full case study (PDF, article), or null.
